- Sample 8 uniformly distributed points along the elliptical contour of splat $j$.

- **Order Independence:** The algorithm marks splats for removal.
If two splats mutually satisfy the removal condition for each other, the order of iteration determines which one survives.
- **Time Complexity:** $O(N^2)$ in the worst case, as it compares every pair of splats.
